# RVRHostApi

The public `rvr-host-api` headers, copied unchanged from the `host_api` repository:

- `rvr/host_api/rvr_host_api.h` -- the C interface;
- `rvr/host_api/rvr_host_api_loader.h` -- finds and loads the implementation RVR installs;
- `rvr/host_api/host_api.hpp` -- the header-only C++ wrapper.

No binary. Copy them again, whole, when `host_api` changes; do not edit them here.
